title: Warranty Registration Workflow Due-Soon Queue
dataSources: Life-admin document records (`lifeadmin:document`), passport status (`passport:status`), warranty registrations (`warranty:registration`), document-scan index (`documentscan:index`), voter-registration records (`voter:registration`).
app: Passport and document trackers, warranty-registration forms, document-scan indexes, and voter-registration reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and mobile capture workflows.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=warranty:registration
| eval days_to_due=round((registration_deadline_epoch-now())/86400,1)
| where days_to_due>=0 AND days_to_due<=14 AND registration_status!="registered"
| table _time product_type registration_status days_to_due
| sort days_to_due
description: Builds a queue of warranty registrations that are due soon but not yet marked complete.
value: Due-soon queues are what keep small admin tasks from turning into expensive or embarrassing misses.
implementation: Populate `registration_deadline_epoch` and normalize `registration_status` so the queue only shows genuinely actionable work.
visualization: Table of due-soon warranty registrations sorted by days remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which warranty registrations are coming due soon and still need attention.
